title: Airplanes that look diff on the inside only?
content: I dream about traveling a lot, usually to real destinations like Hawaii or European countries, and the flights are super fast. I travel from the East Coast to Hawaii in 30 minutes. The airplanes always look like real planes on the outside, but the inside is bizarre. The front third is all windows, and I usually sit behind the pilot like sitting behind a bus driver. Has anyone else dreamed about these or any other variations? The trains and buses are always normal, but it's never that way for me with the planes.
